checks.name: separated articulations keep the original off-grid source clock through both frame modes and signed offsets
lead singing has articulation contrast and keeps bass, percussion and accompaniment active
stable sung pitch and isolated envelope shape real RGB bytes while the exact exterior rhythm stays fixed
instrumental corrections remove measured voice evidence locally and never mutate original analysis
explicit voice guides add a labeled phrase without inventing measured notes or syllables
short articulated phrases and cadences never nominate multi-second motor Dance outside their region
long sustained vocal and bass phrases compete for expressive gestures with full mechanical lead and return
saved and corrected detail is deterministic, masks apply and manual lights keep ownership

limitations: Declared-source fixtures validate choreography, corrections, exact export timing and physical command constraints; audio-estimation accuracy is evaluated separately against real reference stems.
Pitch/articulation remain acoustic estimates, not a lyric transcript or word alignment.
Motor timing and preview dynamics are vehicle estimates, not measured physical Tesla response.
